name: transcendental-rite-banish-makes-champion-ascendant-and-enables-basic-elements
notes: Transcendental Rite had no implementation. Banish self: MakeChampionAscendant() plus tAiiMGZJXp_FIRE/WATER/WIND global effects read by GetPlayerEnabledElements() (the same mechanism as Imperial Seal). A WATER Baby Blue Slime is playable afterwards even though the Spirit of Fire champion only enables FIRE.

rulesClauses: Banish Transcendental Rite: Your champion becomes an Ascendant in addition to its other types. All basic elements are enabled for you until end of turn.

engineBug.summary: Transcendental Rite's banish ability was not implemented.
